mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sales_order (order_no, customer_id, warehouse_id, total_amount, status, salesman_id, order_date, remark, company_id) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{customerId}, #{warehouseId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{salesmanId}, #{orderDate}, #{remark}, #{companyId})
mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT('SO', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), LPAD(COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(order_no, 11) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1, 4, '0')) FROM sales_order WHERE order_no LIKE CONCAT('SO', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), '%')
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO sales_order_item (order_id, product_id, quantity, price, amount, remark) VALUES
(#{item.orderId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.price}, #{item.amount}, #{item.remark})
mapper.sql: so.id, so.order_no, so.customer_id, c.customer_name, so.warehouse_id, so.total_amount, so.status, so.salesman_id, so.order_date, so.remark, so.created_at
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order so LEFT JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.id WHERE 1=1
AND so.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{orderNo}, '%')

SELECT so.id, so.order_no, so.customer_id, c.customer_name, so.warehouse_id, so.total_amount, so.status, so.salesman_id, so.order_date, so.remark, so.created_at, so.updated_at FROM sales_order so LEFT JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.id WHERE so.id = #{id}

SELECT soi.id, soi.order_id, soi.product_id, p.product_name, p.spec, soi.quantity, soi.price, soi.amount FROM sales_order_item soi LEFT JOIN product p ON soi.product_id = p.id WHERE soi.order_id = #{orderId}
